audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf. Levels 4-5 are marked neutral although whys[3] says Olaf wins those trades 'clearly'; level 6 is marked neutral although whys[4] says Ragnarok removes his entire all-in setup; and 2+ items is given to Olaf although whys[6] says the lane 'reads even'.
audit.why: Renekton's whole threat is levels 1-3 and a snowball before 6. After that Olaf out-sustains him until both fall off, which is exactly the packet chart.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, with ratings moved on the rows that changed hands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) An 'empowered-W root' is asserted twice. Ruthless Predator empowered slashes three times and stuns for 1.5 seconds — there is no root anywhere in Renekton's kit. (2) The single most important interaction in this matchup is missing entirely: empowered Ruthless Predator DESTROYS damage shields on the target, which means it deletes the shield from Vicious Strikes outright. Nothing on the page mentions it. (3) 'Ragnarok cleanses his W stun' and 'chase with the bonus move speed toward him' — Ragnarok is immunity to disables held while attacking, and Riot's text grants armour and magic resist, no move speed.
audit.why: The shield-destroy is the reason a full-Fury Renekton all-in beats an Olaf who opened with W: the shield he was counting on simply vanishes. That belongs on the page more than any generic 'track his stun' line. And a player told Ragnarok grants move speed will expect a chase he does not get.
audit.corrected: Empowered Ruthless Predator written with its real effects — 1.5s stun plus shield destruction — at 16s rank 1. The phantom root removed. Ragnarok restated as immunity held while attacking, with the move-speed claim deleted and the sequencing corrected to press it as the stun lands. Slice and Dice named as the 16s gap-closer, Cull the Meek's heal left as the reason Executioner's Calling is already core.

notes: The biggest gap on this page was an omission, not an error: empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target, which deletes the Vicious Strikes shield Olaf just pressed. That is the reason a full-Fury all-in beats him, and it appeared nowhere. It now sits in the tldr, the cooldown breakdown, the don'ts and the interactions line. Also corrected: an 'empowered-W root' asserted twice (it is a 1.5s stun; Renekton has no root), 'Ragnarok cleanses' (it is immunity held while attacking), and a claim that Ragnarok grants bonus move speed for the chase — Riot's text grants armour and magic resist only. Chart flipped three rows in matched pairs. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding, which would deny Slice and Dice if true, but Riot's Undertow text is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only — no grounding claim written.
